Support

Common questions, and how to reach us.

Does the app keep a record of what I read?

No. It keeps only your settings, on your device, and we never receive them.

Where do I change the language or the text size?

In Settings, the last tab. Language, appearance and text sizes are all there.

I found an error in a text

Please tell us. Write to alhassan.mu@gmail.com with the page address and the text concerned. The Quran text is checked against the Tanzil corpus at every build; every other passage is copied from its named edition.

Which languages are available?

You will find every language in Settings. More are being prepared.
